n = int(input())
B = int(input())
a = list(map(int, input().split()))

ce = 0
co = 0
count = []

for i in range(n - 1):
    if a[i] % 2 == 0:
        ce += 1
    else:
        co += 1
    if co == ce:
        count.append(abs(a[i] - a[i + 1]))

count.sort()
sum_value = 0
cou = 0

for c in count:
    sum_value += c
    if sum_value > B:
        break
    cou += 1

print(cou)
</translated_code>
